note: Knob DIFF over the base slice-clip (frs7, clip wipes LEFT->RIGHT, keeps its vertical bronze edge). The base engine (component.js) is parameterized over `dir` and `edge`, so this variant is PURE DATA (CONTRACT §3 preferred path): flip the clip axis to BOTTOM->UP and turn the edge-line OFF. No new DOM layer, no new phase, zero code. Byte-faithful to frs10-slice-td-relay.html (filename says 'relay' for historical reasons; it is now a clip-reveal, bottom->up).

engine.edge: REMOVED on purpose — the bronze edge-line read as a stray horizontal line moving from the opposite side of the wipe, so the bottom-up variant ships edge:false. Do NOT re-add it.
